facts.fact: The paper titled 'Can Hiccup Supply Enough Fish to Maintain a Dragon’s Diet?' was authored by Amal Doua from The Centre for Interdisciplinary Science, University of Leicester.
The paper investigates the feasibility of Hiccup supplying enough fish for Toothless, a Night Fury dragon, who requires 13 Icelandic cod and 56 Atlantic salmon daily.
In total, Hiccup would have needed to carry 828 fish weighing 8592 kg over twelve days to sustain Toothless, which is deemed unrealistic.
The paper was published in the Journal of Interdisciplinary Science Topics, Volume 6, in 2017.
